description: This file defines functions for generating terminal commands within a VSCode extension, including user prompts, terminal context building, and API configuration handling.

methods.name: generateTerminalCommand
methods.description: Main function to generate a terminal command based on user input and context.

methods.name: showWarningIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays a warning dialog if not acknowledged previously.

methods.name: getUserInput
methods.description: Prompts the user for input via an input box.

methods.name: executeCommandGeneration
methods.description: Executes the process of generating and sending a command to the terminal.

methods.name: buildTerminalContext
methods.description: Builds context information about the terminal environment.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by logging and showing messages.

methods.name: getApiConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the API configuration for command generation.
